title: Quality board prices each pick and pins the cheapest model within noise
band_fixed_before_tests: NOISE_BAND = 0.15 composite points when BOTH compared use-case aggregates rest on >= 4 judged scenarios in every op (min judges >= 4), 0.30 otherwise; a candidate is in band when best.composite - candidate.composite <= band. RELIABILITY_FLOOR = 0.9 (min llmRate across the use case's ops; same threshold as the board's LOW_RELIABILITY). A candidate must have a measured cell on every bench op of the use case. Recorded 2026-09-23 before any test was written; not tuned after results.
deviations_from_card: Critic revision applied: band numeric and recorded first (0.15 / 0.30 at judges 4), re-bake passed --judge fable-5, pickRowState has pin_forbidden (reader known not to hold org:manage, from the shell's useCapabilities; unknown capability fails open, the server's MODEL_ADMIN_FORBIDDEN stays the enforcement). pickRowState takes the pins ROWS (not one pinnedRow) plus {measuredModels, canPin}: 'pinned' compares against the EFFECTIVE pin (own row else '*') while the payload's params/expectedUpdatedAt come from the OWN row only (a '*' row's updatedAt is not this use case's version; no own row -> null, which the PUT's stale guard reads as 'I saw no pin'). Added a fifth row state provider_unavailable and a fifth reason no_reliable_candidate (all candidates under the floor). Acceptance 3 (re-bake reproduces every value) was verified by the actual re-bake diff (only a comma + costPerTaskUsd per cell and the targets block) and is pinned in TS by 'the shipped bake is priced and names a bench target for every model' + the existing 'opus top on 12 of 15' guard, not by a Python test reading git-ignored tmp/ records (that would add a skip against KP_SKIP_BASELINE). bake_quality now writes the TS with newline='\n' (a Windows bake wrote CRLF). Commits: catalog keys and doc first (each alone under the lock), then the Python half (bake + tests, green without the regenerated file), then the TS half with the regenerated scores; no red test-only commit, because every commit stays green. Exported helper modelOnUseCase (a name that does not start with 'use', which rules-of-hooks flagged).
notes: Re-bake was FREE and real: tmp/bench/round-20260811/n4-{api-keep,api2-keep,api3,cli}/records.jsonl already carry judge scores and cost_usd (60/60 cells priced, 0 null) - no live judge call and no fabricated number. Computed picks on the shipped data: match_reasoning gemini-3.6-flash (9.0, $0.0036/task, opus 9.1 at 68x), campaign_pack deepseek-v4-flash (opus 8.7 at ~286x), jd_ingest deepseek (best_is_cheapest), weight_proposal opus 8.8, automation opus as only_candidate (every other column has an op at llmRate 0.75 - the rule, stated in the doc), the rest best_is_cheapest. tsc: exit 1 ONLY on untracked kpi-sim/runs/** (foreign, pre-existing, same as slot A). test:perf red ONLY on siblings' uncommitted work: measured HEAD + my 4 TS files alone in a git-archive scratch tree -> app/page.tsx 1412 modules / 8940 KB vs ceiling 1423 / 8995 (base 1411 / 8919): my share +1 module, +21 KB, inside the ceiling, no raise; the API-route overages touch no file of mine. test:python:gate: 3014 run, 1 failure = test_analysis_prompt_version_sync fingerprint, caused by a sibling's uncommitted pipeline/jobfit/models.py + authenticity.py + trust.py (not mine); skips 4 (baseline untouched); my 11 bake tests green. Full test:unit 10590/10590 green. No route touched (the Pin reuses PUT /api/llm/config). UI not visually verified in a browser (no dev/build allowed) - both-theme check is owed; it composes PANEL, CHIP_QUIET, BTN_SECONDARY and token colours only (design:check 0, lint 0).
